brief:
Al Jazeera English reported that Israel has advanced Gaza's Yellow Line westward, forcing displaced families in Shujayea to flee again. The Yellow Line marks a boundary that Israeli forces have repeatedly shifted, each time leaving residents with fewer safe areas in the territory.

Families already displaced by the conflict now face renewed displacement as the boundary moves. The shifting demarcation has compounded the humanitarian crisis, leaving civilians with diminishing options for shelter and safety in an already devastated region.
dek: As Israel moves Gaza’s Yellow Line westward, displaced families in Shujayea face renewed danger.
title: Israel moves Gaza's Yellow Line westward, displacing families anew
